description: Tells the Muster daemon that owns this pane what Codex is doing: working, waiting on you or idle, how many sub-agents it runs, its model and how full its context is, and the session's id for resuming it after a restart.

hooks.command: [ -z "$MUSTER_PANE" ] || [ -z "$MUSTER_DAEMON" ] || echo 'In Muster: to wait for a message or a person, just end your turn. Only when you end a turn to wait on work you started (a build, a background job, a sub-agent), first run "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --waiting "<what>". When it is an answer from another pane, add --until-message-from <its callsign>: without it the wait outlives the answer. Nothing wakes you when a job you started in the background ends, so for one add --until-exits <its pid> (the $! after starting it with &): Muster then messages you when it exits. A wait without it ends after 10 minutes.'

[ -n "$MUSTER_DAEMON" ] || exit 0; input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"session_id"'*) printf '%s' "$input" | "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --agent codex --from session-id=/session_id --from session-source=/source >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '%s' "$input" | "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --agent codex --from session-id=/session_id >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

[ -n "$MUSTER_DAEMON" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; input=$(cat); transcript=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model // empty' 2>/dev/null); used=; [ -f "$transcript" ] && used=$(tail -c 65536 "$transcript" | grep '"type":"token_count"' | tail -n 1 | jq -r '.payload.info // empty | select(.model_context_window > 12000) | (.last_token_usage.total_tokens - 12000) * 100 / (.model_context_window - 12000) | if . < 0 then 0 elif . > 100 then 100 else . end' 2>/dev/null); set --; [ -n "$used" ] && set -- --context-used "$used"; [ -n "$model" ] && set -- "$@" --model "$model"; [ $# -gt 0 ] || exit 0; { "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report "$@"; } </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0
[ -n "$MUSTER_DAEMON" ] || exit 0; case "$(cat)" in *'"agent_id"'*) exit 0 ;; esac; "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --agent codex --context-compacted >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

[ -n "$MUSTER_DAEMON" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"agent_id"'*) exit 0 ;; esac; transcript=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -f "$transcript" ] || exit 0; { tries=0; while :; do line=$(awk '/"type":"compacted"/ { compacted = NR; first = 0 } /"type":"token_count"/ { counted = NR; if (compacted && !first) { first = NR; line = $0 } } END { if (first && first == counted) print line }' "$transcript"); [ -n "$line" ] || [ $tries -ge 20 ] && break; tries=$((tries + 1)); sleep 0.25; done; used=$(printf '%s' "$line" | jq -r '.payload.info // empty | select(.model_context_window > 12000) | (.last_token_usage.total_tokens - 12000) * 100 / (.model_context_window - 12000) | if . < 0 then 0 elif . > 100 then 100 else . end' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$used" ] && "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --context-used "$used"; } </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0

[ -n "$MUSTER_DAEMON" ] && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; input=$(cat); transcript=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model // empty' 2>/dev/null); used=; [ -f "$transcript" ] && used=$(tail -c 65536 "$transcript" | grep '"type":"token_count"' | tail -n 1 | jq -r '.payload.info // empty | select(.model_context_window > 12000) | (.last_token_usage.total_tokens - 12000) * 100 / (.model_context_window - 12000) | if . < 0 then 0 elif . > 100 then 100 else . end' 2>/dev/null); effort=; [ -f "$transcript" ] && effort=$(grep -F '"type":"turn_context"' "$transcript" | tail -n 1 | jq -r '.payload.effort // empty' 2>/dev/null); set --; [ -n "$used" ] && set -- --context-used "$used"; [ -n "$model" ] && set -- "$@" --model "$model"; [ -n "$effort" ] && set -- "$@" --effort "$effort"; [ $# -gt 0 ] || exit 0; { "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report "$@"; } </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0
